email.subject: Evergreen Heating & Cooling's site on phones
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I checked Evergreen Heating & Cooling's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: it isn't set up for mobile, so anyone searching "HVAC near me" on their phone gets a broken layout and probably leaves; and your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people who want to know if you're open now can't tell and just call a competitor instead.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee, no retainer.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what's broken and what I'd change. No pressure either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
